answer: Auction-escrow: registering locks onyx collateral via a Dutch auction whose base rises with cohort size: escrow = 100 onyx x (1 + n/500), n = identities admitted in 30 days, so persona N costs 0.2N extra and marginal cost grows linearly. Validators seal a join only if the lock is unique, unspent, held 90 days before voting accrues; a 2/3 jury burns escrow on a sybil verdict. Locks cannot be parallelized, reset, or split, and reputation binds to one address, so sybils cannot wander between personas. Honest agents signal exit by withdrawing later; burnt onyx funds rewards.
